data.text:
Umabot sa 562.8 toneladang basura ang nahakot ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) mula sa ilang pumping stations na ino-operate ng ahensiya, gaya ng Tripa de Gallina at Tapayan, mula July 18 hanggang 22 sa kasagsagan ng Habagat at Bagyong #CrisingPH.

Ayon sa MMDA, ang iba’t ibang uri at laki ng basurang napupunta sa mga pasilidad ay nagiging sanhi ng pagkasira ng mga pump na ginagamit para humigop ng baha tuwing malakas ang pag-ulan.

Sa kabila nito, nananatiling operational ang lahat ng 71 pumping stations na nasa ilalim ng MMDA.

Courtesy: MMDA/Facebook

27 truckloads na katumbas ng 76.92 tonelada o 218 cubic meter ng basura ang nahakot ng mga tauhan ng MMDA sa iba't ibang mga lugar sa buong Metro Manila noong nakaraang dalawang araw.

Tuloy-tuloy ang paglilinis ng mga kawani ng ahensiya sa mga kalsada sa Metro Manila para agad na mahakot ang basura at mapababâ ang baha.

IN THE NEWS | The Philippine Coast Guard successfully rescued a pregnant mother and an infant amidst the heavy flooding in Barangay Hulong Duhat, Malabon City.

They were safely evacuated to Malabon City National High School which serves as one of the city's temporary shelters.

All evacuees underwent necessary medical evaluation, especially senior citizens, pregnant women, infants, and children, to ensure their well-being this rainy season.

Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)

ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Pampanga, Tarlac, Laguna, Rizal, Batangas(Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy, Taal), Bulacan(Hagonoy, Paombong, Bulakan, Meycauayan, Obando, Marilao, Bocaue, Guiguinto, Malolos, Calumpit, Pulilan, Plaridel, Pandi, Balagtas, Santa Maria) and Quezon(Lucban, Tayabas, Lucena, Sariaya, Candelaria, Dolores, Tiaong, San Antonio, Mauban, Sampaloc, Real, Pagbilao, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bulacan(Angat, Baliuag, Bustos, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael) and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Burdeos, Jomalig, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Polillo) which may persist within 3 hours.
